title.zh: 【Circle：2026 上半年收入约 14 亿美元，59% 分给 USDC 合作伙伴】
title.en: 【Circle：2026 上半年收入约 14 亿美元，59% 分给 USDC 合作伙伴】

current_state.zh: Circle reported roughly $1.4B in H1 2026 revenue with 59% going to USDC distribution partners and ~7% net margin, while introducing free, 24/7 near-real-time USDC redemption for customers using Circle Payment Network or Circle platform products.
current_state.en: Circle reported roughly $1.4B in H1 2026 revenue with 59% going to USDC distribution partners and ~7% net margin, while introducing free, 24/7 near-real-time USDC redemption for customers using Circle Payment Network or Circle platform products.
